image_description: A close-up view of a suit of historical armor, specifically focusing on the torso. The central element is a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) with a raised center ridge and anatomical contouring. It is flanked by blue chainmail sleeves (voiders) and topped with articulated pauldrons (shoulder armor). Below the breastplate are layered tassets (skirt armor) and a fauld. To the right, a portion of a sword hilt is visible. The metal surfaces show signs of wear, patina, and decorative rivets.
